CF_PACK_BALDURS_DESCRIPTION: Three FTK II x Baldur's Gate 3 crossover classes: Hexblade Warlock, Battle Master, and Necromancer.
CF_WARLOCK_HEXBLADE_DESCRIPTION: A duelist bound to a pact that trades vitality for arcane power.
CF_BATTLEMASTER_DESCRIPTION: A martial tactician whose maneuvers control the battlefield row by row.
CF_NECROMANCER_DESCRIPTION: A caster who raises the fallen to fight at their command.
CF_SKELETON_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION: An animated skeleton bound to fight for its summoner.
TRAIT_CF_BALDURS_PACT_BOON_DESCRIPTION: Your patron's gift sharpens focus and mind.
TRAIT_CF_BALDURS_COMBAT_SUPERIORITY_DESC: A killing blow lets you act again.
TRAIT_CF_BALDURS_TACTICAL_MIND_DESCRIPTI: Years of drilling sharpen awareness and prowess.
TRAIT_CF_BALDURS_UNDEAD_LEGION_DESCRIPTI: Commanding the dead has hardened you as well.
TRAIT_CF_BALDURS_DEATHS_DESIGN_DESCRIPTI: Life drained from others returns to sustain you.
CF_ITEM_PACT_BLADE_DESCRIPTION: A blade bound to its wielder's infernal pact.
CF_ITEM_COMMANDERS_LONGSWORD_DESCRIPTION: A well-balanced blade favored by battlefield tacticians.
CF_ITEM_NECROTIC_STAFF_DESCRIPTION: A staff humming with the cold power of the grave.
CF_ITEM_BONE_CLAWS_DESCRIPTION: Jagged bone claws grown from an animated skeleton's own hands.
